entries.english:
Matters concerning the parish of Rinderfeld.

Contains: 1. Petition by Zaisolf von Rosenberg to Margrave Georg Friedrich of Brandenburg-Ansbach for confirmation of Kilian Graiß as pastor of Rinderfeld (later copy), 1563; 2. disputes between Zaisolf von Rosenberg and Brandenburg-Ansbach over the pastor's payment in kind, 1570–1672; 3. complaints about Pastor Hans Seubold of Rinderfeld and the dismissal of Pastor Johann Mauck for publishing uncensored sermons, 1591, 1625–1626; 4. negotiations between Rosenberg and Brandenburg-Ansbach over filling the Rinderfeld parish, 1626–1631; 5. agreement between Hatzfeldt and Brandenburg-Ansbach concerning patronage, nomination, and visitation rights in the parishes of Rinderfeld and Waldmannshofen (copy), 1649; 6. departure of Pastor Nikolaus Rosenberg zu Rinderfeld without manorial authorization and petition by Pastor Johann Conrad Donner zu Riedbach for transfer to the parish, 1646, 1649–1650; 7. agreement between Margrave Albrecht of Brandenburg-Ansbach and Johann Philipp, Archbishop of Mainz and Bishop of Würzburg, concerning the right to ordain, invest, and visit several parishes, including Rinderfeld (copy), 1650–1651.

Extent: 1 file
